topic: Capstone Demonstration, Review, and Future Enhancements
learningObjectives: Demonstrate the complete data science solution from input to output.
Evaluate project results against defined success criteria.
Identify practical improvements and future extensions for the solution.

activities.title: Capstone Walkthrough
activities.instruction: Explore how the complete solution moves from user input or raw data to the final output.

content.concept: A capstone demonstration shows how each component works together to solve the defined data science problem.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Provides raw or user-generated information to the solution.
Cleans, validates, and transforms incoming data.
Creates or selects the features required by the model.
Makes the model available to an application or workflow.
Displays or uses the prediction or analytical result.
Tracks system and model behavior after deployment.

activities.title: System Architecture Review
activities.instruction: Inspect how the final components connect and exchange data.

content.concept: Architecture review verifies that data, models, APIs, storage, and user outputs work together coherently.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Prepares and validates the incoming data.
Receives prediction requests and invokes the model.
Consumes and presents the prediction to users.
Tracks errors, latency, data quality, and model behavior.

activities.title: Results Review
activities.instruction: Match project results with the criteria used to evaluate the solution.

content.concept: Project evaluation compares observed results with predefined technical and project objectives.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Classification Model → Accuracy, Precision, Recall, or F1
Regression Model → MAE, RMSE, or R²
Prediction API → Response correctness and latency
Data Pipeline → Data quality and processing reliability
config.answer: Classification Model → Accuracy, Precision, Recall, or F1

activities.title: Enhancement Planner
activities.instruction: Build a roadmap for practical future improvements.

content.concept: Future enhancements can target data quality, model performance, scalability, usability, monitoring, security, or new capabilities.
